outcome: neurosteroid levels (dehydroepiandrosterone-sulfate, progesterone, pregnenolone, pregnenolone-sulfate, allopregnanolone, isopregnanolone, epipregnanolone, pregnanolone and pregnanolone-sulfate)
finding: All nine neurosteroid levels declined significantly during the first 2 days of life, with a more pronounced decline observed in vaginal deliveries and a trend towards a larger decline with more exposure to STS.
mod_finding: The decline in neurosteroid levels was generally more pronounced in vaginal deliveries.
